# Jengara Labs — Proprietary AI Software

Jengara BV is a Netherlands-incorporated AI software company. Jengara Labs is its product development division. The company has discontinued advisory and consulting services.

Contact: hello@jengara.ai
Website: https://jengara.ai/
Products: https://jengara.ai/labs/

## Products
- RibyOS: agent orchestration, execution, governance and observability. Design partners targeted for January 2027. https://ribyos.ai/
- Tesseryn: AI-powered cybersecurity and infrastructure risk intelligence integrating vulnerability context, network topology and service dependencies. Design partners targeted for January 2027. https://tesseryn.ai/
- PromptPresence: generative AI brand visibility and analytics. Targeted launch October 2026. https://promptpresence.ai/

The launch and onboarding dates above are targets, not assertions of general availability.
